knowledge_tree.title: English Compulsory Book 2
knowledge_tree.content: High school English textbook focusing on themes like cultural heritage, wildlife protection, the internet, history and traditions, and music.

children.title: Cultural Heritage
children.content: Understanding and preserving cultural heritage, including historical sites and traditions.

children.title: Definition of Cultural Heritage
children.content: Legacy from the past passed to future generations, including tangible and intangible elements.

children.title: Examples of Cultural Heritage
children.content: Includes temples, palaces, traditions, customs, and knowledge like dances and crafts.

children.title: Protection of Cultural Heritage
children.content: Efforts to preserve cultural sites and traditions from damage or extinction.

children.title: Aswan Dam Project
children.content: Project to build a dam while preserving temples and cultural relics in Egypt.

children.title: Role of UNESCO
children.content: UNESCO's program to protect world cultural heritage sites.

children.title: Digital Preservation
children.content: Using digital images and technology to record and promote cultural heritage.

children.title: Wildlife Protection
children.content: Efforts to protect endangered species and their habitats.

children.title: Endangered Species
children.content: Species at risk of extinction due to human activities.

children.title: Tibetan Antelope
children.content: Protected species in China, recovered from endangerment through conservation efforts.

children.title: Elephants
children.content: Threatened by hunting and habitat loss; protected through parks and awareness.

children.title: Conservation Measures
children.content: Actions taken to protect wildlife, such as reserves and laws.

children.title: Habitat Protection
children.content: Creating and maintaining natural reserves for wildlife.

children.title: Anti-Poaching Efforts
children.content: Measures to prevent illegal hunting and trade of animal products.

children.title: Community Involvement
children.content: Role of local communities and volunteers in wildlife protection.

children.title: The Internet
children.content: Impact of the internet on society, communication, and learning.

children.title: Benefits of the Internet
children.content: Convenience, access to information, and global connectivity.

children.title: Online Communities
children.content: Virtual groups that provide support and foster connections.

children.title: Virtual Choir
children.content: Online choir created by Eric Whitacre, allowing global participation.

children.title: Digital Divide
children.content: Gap between those with and without access to digital technology.

children.title: Online Safety
children.content: Practices to protect privacy and avoid cyberbullying and scams.

children.title: History and Traditions
children.content: Exploring historical events and cultural traditions.

children.title: United Kingdom History
children.content: Formation and history of the UK, including its four countries.

children.title: Formation of the UK
children.content: Historical events leading to the union of England, Wales, Scotland, and Northern Ireland.

children.title: Cultural Influences
children.content: Impact of Romans, Anglo-Saxons, Vikings, and Normans on British culture.

children.title: Cultural Traditions
children.content: Customs, festivals, and practices that define cultures.

children.title: Irish Traditions
children.content: Music, dancing, and dining traditions in Ireland.

children.title: Chinese Traditions
children.content: Examples include Confucian philosophy and traditional practices.

children.title: Music
children.content: Role of music in culture, communication, and personal expression.

children.title: Types of Music
children.content: Various genres like classical, hip-hop, country, and traditional.

children.title: Music and Emotions
children.content: How music influences feelings and provides comfort or inspiration.

children.title: Virtual Music Experiences
children.content: Using technology to create and share music globally.

children.title: Virtual Choir
children.content: Eric Whitacre's project enabling online choir participation.

children.title: Music Festivals
children.content: Events that celebrate music and bring people together.
